recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is and do not add proposed/planned status codes under FHIR-7640. Future intent-code or common request-code-system work should be handled under later intent-specific issues.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue FHIR-7640 asked to align MedicationPrescription.status with other request resources so medication prescriptions could be proposed, planned, or otherwise aligned with request-resource status handling.
initial_application: Git commit 50cda04a97f78cbba13ffec2774fceb4e777297e explicitly applied #7640 by updating the then-current MedicationOrder status binding/list name and lifecycle status definitions after MedicationPrescription had been renamed to MedicationOrder. It did not add proposed or planned as status codes.
additional_context: MedicationPrescription is now MedicationRequest in the active build. The current Request pattern separates Request.status lifecycle states from immutable Request.intent values such as proposal, plan, and order. Later Pharmacy issue FHIR-9266 explicitly resolved no-change for adding proposed/planned statuses to MedicationOrder, and later MedicationRequest.intent issues FHIR-13704 and FHIR-20605 are already represented on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is appropriate because adding proposed or planned to MedicationRequest.status would contradict the Request pattern and the later Pharmacy no-change decision; current MedicationRequest.intent already carries the requested semantics.
